title: Attendance
description: Mark attendance for students enrolled in the batch for a scheduled class. Unmarked students are not counted as absent.
selectBatchHint: Select a batch to see its classes and attendance.
emptyClasses: No classes in this date range.
emptyStudents: No students are enrolled in this batch.
cancelledNotice: This class is cancelled. Existing attendance can be corrected. New students cannot be marked.
markAllBody: Every student in this list will be set to present. Nothing is saved until you choose Save attendance.
formula: Attendance percentage = Present ÷ (Present + Absent + Late) × 100. Excused records are left out. Late is not counted as present. Classes with no saved row are not absences.
summaryEmpty: No attendance has been recorded for this range.
historyEmpty: No attendance records match these filters.
